nodes.description: Component node IDs to combine (≥2 required)

variants.description: Variant axis values for each component. Use the same axis keys in every entry. The tool names each component in Figma's "Axis=Value, ..." form before combining. Omit this field when the existing component names already define the axes.

props.description: Variant axis values for this component, e.g. {"Size":"Small","State":"Default"}

name: combine_components
